title: Having a Guide Brings it to Life
text: This was a great tour. Miguel (the cute one) really made it meaningful and fun. Without a guide it is just a lot of cool stuff to look at without any context.  If you’re going to do the Alcazar I’d highly recommend this tour!
author: ktwangler

title: Well Worth the Extra Money!
text: Our guide, Miguel (the good looking one) was excellent and made the experience so much more meaningful than just walking through the Alcazar would have been.  There wasn’t as much info about GOT as I would have loved but I guess other than they filmed there - maybe there wasn’t much to say.  Anyway, it was a great tour and I would highly recommend it.
author: kwangler

title: Guided visit inside Alcazar
text: The tour description mentions Osuna, however, this tour does NOT include Osuna. The organization to get to Alcazar was a bit chaotic, but Ismael, that did the tour was an amazing guide. He brought so much good energy, is very knowledgeable and is a really funny guy. Just for that, the tour was more than worth it!
author: Alyssa M

title: Awesome Blend of History & GOT Info
text: We loved this tour.  We really wanted a blend of history and GOT information.  I feel like this tour hit a really nice blend of the two.  We had two guides, Lola and Clara.  Both were great!  I loved their enthusiasm for both GOT and the Alcazar!
author: PassionForTravel42

title: The guide is wonderful
text: Wonderful, I loved the way he has to explain everything to you. It's not the same to see the scenarios tell you a little bit about everything. Recommended 😍
author: 122nanaq

title: An amazing experience
text:
Lola took us on a very nice and insightful tour of the Alcazar of Seville. As a Game of Thrones fan, this guided tour was amazing. Lola has a true passion and love for Seville and the world of Game of Thrones. She knows all of the interresting facts about the beautiful palace, and she loves to tell stories and show pictures from the set of Game of Thrones. 
We’ve had a very pleasent experience with Sevilla4Real, and will gladly recommend them to anyone visiting the beautiful city of Seville.
author: Lasse R

title: Amazing Game of Thrones experience at the Alcazar
text:
Amazing experience with our guide Lola! She was very passioned about Game of Thrones (show and books) and about the history of the Alcazar. We learned a lot about the shooting places and Lola gave us a lot of interesting anecdotes.
We could not have imagined a better guide !
author: antoined457

title: Perfecto tour
text:
Amazing tour, we learnt a lot about game of thrones shoot and the alcazar history. 
The guide was passionnate and very interesting.
author: B9377SBcharlottel

title: Direct hit
text: The tour with Lola was totally interesting. She is a big game of thrones fan, as we are, and knew a lot of stories about the shooting in Seville and what was going on behind the scenes. The lead was led during the corona pandemic and despite various restrictions such as not being able to enter rooms or running freely everywhere, it was a direct hit.
author: 689ellib

title: Magical gardens
text: It was a great experience. The guide Christina knew a lot about not only the show itself, but also about the history of the castle!
author: Lukas_W
